contracts.routing: Spin one of seven Golem types. Commit its material identity and approved fixed grants/modifiers, then react. Element Golem registers +1 shared Power Mastery, completes one universal Element spin and gains its canonical manipulation power once; restore saved caller.
contracts.fixedGrants: Sand/Rock/Magma/Crystal/Diamond/Trash each grant one canonical material manipulation power without a separate Power acquisition spin. Element Golem grants only the canonical manipulation power from its selected Element outcome, without a second generic elemental power.
contracts.profileAuthority: Profiles here are canonical; inline effects and pointers are mirrors, not extra independent invocations.
contracts.elementClassification: An Element result remains a Golem component and does not dispatch the Elemental race or consume another race-family selection.
contracts.inheritedOrigins: Authorized Skeleton/Zombie origin and Hybrid/host callers use the same approved profile, actual component provenance, saved return and race no-repeat history.
contracts.size: All types retain global Size. Body metric and source-backed reference profiles remain unset; material names do not establish height/length or grant extra Size spins.
contracts.weights: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization.
contracts.idempotence: Each profile/caller effect and Element child invocation is consumed once by run/component/sourceSpinId/profile key. Replay and media retries create no extra grants or spins.

materialPowerAuthority.localDefinitions: Five Rock/Magma/Crystal/Diamond/Trash definitions live here; future authorized callers reference the same IDs.
materialPowerAuthority.sand: Reuse sand-manipulation from lelembut-events-design.json; no copy or Lelembut family dispatch.
materialPowerAuthority.element: Reuse element-universal and its canonical linked power; no caller-specific wheel or duplicate generic elemental grant.

numericDurability.timing: Append one source modifier on committed type selection and add after the actual immutable base Durability roll, using configured numeric bounds.
numericDurability.independence: These user-set +1/+2/+3 amounts do not automatically scale with Power Mastery. Other Golem types have no declared flat Durability bonus.

powerMasteryModifiers.status: User-confirmed +1 Power Mastery for Element Golem only; uses the established one shared character rank.
powerMasteryModifiers.timing: Register the original authorized source modifier once when earned. Resolve raw mastery/Resilient at the ordinary scheduled stage; calculate this bonus only in final bonus phase from the retained immutable base, never at the earlier draw.
powerMasteryModifiers.qualifies: The one shared character Power Mastery record and all current/future owned powers referring to it.
powerMasteryModifiers.emptyInventory: No owned power means no mastery draw or phantom power. The modifier does not generate another Power acquisition.
powerMasteryModifiers.cap: No numeric final floor/cap; raw mastery0..9 remains separate.
powerMasteryModifiers.callerGuard: Only an actual committed element-golem type result. The universal Element wheel and Elemental race do not grant this modifier.

contracts.bonusTiming: All authorized numeric main-stat/mastery bonuses register at their original source and calculate only in final bonus phase. Compatible Weapon Enchant uses effective mastery after bonuses there; no earlier Enchant child.
